name: beam-splitter
description: A square optical cube with a diagonal splitting surface and three light paths.
useCase: Identify a component that divides an incident light beam into transmitted and reflected paths.
misuse: Use a label to name the component; this symbol is not a scaled optical drawing.

16.reason: Short light paths meet the cube without protruding into the two clear triangular faces.

24.reason: The diagonal face remains separated from both open areas, while all three light paths stay inside the square drawing frame.
